items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Your sister's name then was Amide. A-M-I-D-E. [INTERVIEWEE] A-M-I-D-E.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't keep records, but you'd be surprised I had my mother's marriage license. You did have, you did say? Yes, indeed. I have a marriage license and I have my birth certificate. No, I didn't have my birth certificate. In order for me to get Social Security, I had to use my marriage license. And they contacted, but I did have a birth certificate because when I made my communion, you had to take it to the cathedral. And that was the last year... You must have had something.
